name: Ljus
source:
"Did you know? That the two angels that smited Sodom and Gommorrah, have gotten a new target to smite?"

But since Abraham or Lot are not available this time, they need to find someone else to answer the question that needs to be asked before initiating the smiting (The Holiest of Deaths).
"Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?"

[From F95Zone]
